cognitive_unit_reviews.solution_rubric: In the described ordinary home setup, smartphones use the modem's integrated Wi-Fi instead of mobile data. Interpret the given connectivity model, not an unrestricted theorem that every internet-connected phone proves a modem has Wi-Fi.

A correctly connected and configured access point placed near weak-coverage rooms can extend home Wi-Fi access. Physical proximity alone without a working modem uplink does not guarantee internet service.

An isolated switch connects the desktops locally but has no described path to the modem/internet. The statement explicitly omits that connection; local connectivity alone does not supply the required gateway.

cognitive_unit_reviews.solution_rubric: The schema explicitly gives each station a unique maTram; this identifies TRAM rows and supplies the intended primary key.

A station can have multiple monthly rainfall rows in one year. maTram plus nam therefore does not uniquely identify MUA rows; thang is also needed in the stated one-value-per-station-month model. Two different months in2020 are a direct counterexample.
TRAM supplies station name and MUA supplies year, month and rainfall. Joining those two on maTram supplies all requested attributes; temperature data is not requested.

The proposed join includes TRAM and MUA, but projection/filter use NHIETDO. Without joining the temperature table those attributes are unavailable. A2020condition does not repair the missing relation.
